title: Sky Lantern Festival Wedding Website with RSVP, Paper Lantern Opening Digital Invitation, Online Editor, Dusk Sky
description:
A wedding website that opens with a glowing paper lantern rising into the dusk sky, with online RSVP built in. You fill it in yourself on your phone or computer and share one link with your guests. No Canva, no app, no account.

A watercolor sky from deep violet to a warm amber horizon, rice-paper lanterns and soft star dust. Your guests tap the lantern: it glows warm, the hands let it go and it rises into the dusk sky while distant lanterns drift up behind it; in its light a rice-paper card with your photo appears. Your invitation follows: Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP.

TRY THE LIVE DEMO
See the lantern rise on your own phone before you buy (sample names):
https://davetiye-platform-five.vercel.app/start/demo/sky-lantern-festival
Copy the link into your phone's browser.

WHAT YOU GET
• Your wedding website in the Sky Lantern Festival design: the lantern opening, Home, Our Story, Details and RSVP pages
• A private online editor, designed for phone screens and also working on a computer, with a preview of every page
• Online RSVP: replies, head counts and up to 10 questions of your own (choices, yes/no, short or long answer, number); you choose which fields are required
• Download every reply as an Excel file (or CSV) in one tap, or connect a Google Sheet that updates with every new reply
• Add-to-calendar buttons for guests (Apple / Outlook and Google Calendar)
• 5 photo spots with cropping (a portrait and three photos for your story that light up as lanterns rise past them, plus the venue), a countdown, dress code, travel & stay and registry buttons, and up to 12 questions & answers
• A map of your venue on the Details page (Google Maps loads only when a guest taps it) and directions with Google Maps, Apple Maps or Waze
• Soft background music on your Our Story page (one of 4 tracks made for your website, or your own MP3 or M4A file) and gentle sound effects as the lantern rises. Turn either off if you like; guests can mute the sound with one tap
• A QR code of your website (PNG or SVG) for printed cards and signs
• An optional guest password, and a thank-you page for after the wedding
• A START HERE guide (PDF) with your start link and every step explained
• Your website stays online until 12 months after your wedding date

HOW IT WORKS IN 3 STEPS
1. Start: download the START HERE PDF from your Etsy purchases, open the start link and enter your Etsy order number, email and first names. Your private draft is created right away.
2. Personalize: add your names, date and a photo in a short 3-step setup, then anything else whenever you like. Every change saves by itself.
3. Publish & share: tap Publish, then send your link by text, WhatsApp or email, or print the QR code. Guest replies appear in your editor.

WHAT YOU CAN CHANGE
• Your names and how they appear
• Date, ceremony time and time zone; month-first or day-first date style
• Venue, address, map and directions, a separate reception place, and the order of the day (up to 10 rows)
• Your story: an intro line, three captions and its music (one of 4 tracks, your own file or none)
• 5 photos: a portrait, 3 story photos and the venue, each cropped to its frame
• Questions & answers (up to 12), dress code, travel & stay and registry links
• RSVP deadline and your reply form: required or optional fields and up to 10 questions of your own
• The design's headings, labels and buttons, in your own words (for example "Under the evening sky" or "Kindly respond")
• Which optional sections show
What stays as designed: the artwork, colors, fonts, page layout and the lantern animation.

WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
Your link opens a paper lantern held in cupped hands under a dusk sky. One tap sends it up into the sky and opens your pages. Guests reply on the RSVP page and add your date to their calendar. They need no app and no account, and an email address is optional. Most messaging apps show a preview card with your names and date. Your website is not listed on Google: only people with your link or QR code can open it.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A phone or computer with a web browser
• Your Etsy order number (in your Etsy order confirmation)
• Your wedding details; photos are optional
No Canva account, no app, no design skills.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Digital product: nothing is printed or shipped. Nothing to fill in at checkout.
• One website per order. You choose your web address when you start (for example …/sophie-and-daniel); it cannot be changed later. A custom domain (yournames.com) is not included.
• Save your private edit link when it appears: it opens your editor, and we cannot email it to you yet.
• We confirm each order in our shop before a website can go live. You can set everything up in the meantime.
• After you publish, names and date can be changed 3 times in total; typo fixes and moving the date by up to 7 days are always free. Everything else can be changed as often as you like.
• The website's built-in messages (reply form errors, calendar text) are in English. You can write your own texts and headings in any language.
• Colors and fonts do not change. Music plays only on your Our Story page, and some phones wait for a guest's tap before it starts. Upload only music you have the right to use.
• The painted design elements and the sample photos were made with AI image tools from our own descriptions, then edited and assembled by us. Sample names, dates, places and photos are fictional.
• No returns, exchanges or cancellations: this is a digital product with instant access. If something on your website does not work as described, message us on Etsy and we will fix it.

QUESTIONS?
Message us here on Etsy. We reply within 24 hours.
